ctx.x: Yeah. He was a violin player, too. Bruce played
lead violin with our show but on the jazz records, we would use him as a banjo, you see.

And...I just wanted to see if there was anybody else that we had not talked about. Oh, James...James Jackson, the one who wrote that "Teddy Bear," he was--was he the one that was known as "Tuba Jack"? That's what...it says here that there was someone named James "Tuba Jack" Jackson...
